# Contributor Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

Contributors and maintainers of this repository pledge to provide a harassment-free, respectful, welcoming, and professional community experience for everyone.

## Expected behavior

Examples of positive behavior include:

- demonstrating empathy and kindness
- respecting differing viewpoints and experiences
- giving and receiving constructive feedback professionally
- accepting responsibility for mistakes and correcting them
- focusing on what is best for the project and community

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, threats, personal attacks, discriminatory conduct, sexualized language or imagery, deliberate publication of private information, or other conduct inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, issues, pull requests, discussions, or other contributions that violate these standards. Serious or repeated violations may result in temporary or permanent participation restrictions.

For moderation concerns, contact Next Page Technologies Pvt. Ltd. at `hello@nextpagetechnologies.com`.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies in repository spaces and when an individual is officially representing this project in public spaces.

## Attribution

This policy is based on the Contributor Covenant, version 2.0: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/0/code_of_conduct.html
